evidence_summary: Algal oil is a common non-fish source of DHA and, in some products, EPA.
It may be relevant for people who avoid fish, but dose and EPA/DHA composition vary by product.
The evidence for health outcomes belongs to the actual EPA/DHA exposure, not simply the label 'algal oil'.
personalization: Determine whether formulation-specific evidence differs from parent ingredient; no unvalidated dose conversion or automatic clinical claim.
review_tasks: Verify primary evidence and formulation differences
Reconcile canonical questions and safety gates
Validate applicability before recommendation or dose activation
